sentences.text: To anchor, choose a spot with good holding bottom, shelter from the expected wind, and room to swing a full circle without hitting anything.
Approach slowly into the wind or current and stop over the spot.
Lower the anchor to the bottom, never throw it, since a thrown anchor tangles its own rode.
Let the boat drift or back slowly downwind as you pay out scope.
Snub the line to let the anchor bite, then set it firmly with gentle reverse.
Finally, take bearings on two landmarks or set a GPS anchor alarm, so you’ll know if you start to drag.
